lines: The threefold holding of this — in self,
by embracing, tracking-nature — grasps: she is
the Goddess Śrīparā herself, named by other
l4.sanskrit_cite: etat trividhaṃ yayā dhāraṇam ātmany eva kroḍīkāreṇa anusandhānātmanā grasate sā asya bhagavatī śrīparaiva śrīmanmātṛsadbhāvakālakarṣiṇyādiśabdāntaraniruktā

reads_against.argmap: Which power holds the threefold in self? → Śrīparā double-duty: the triadic bearer (u32) AND the kroḍī-holder of the three — same Goddess, two functions.
c1_essence: Śrīparā again: holds the threefold in self by embrace-tracking — named Śrīmat-mātṛ-sat-bhāva-kāla-karṣiṇī.
